;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Twin suicide bombings in [[Damboa]], [[Nigeria]], leave at least 31 people dead. The explosions are reportedly followed by rockets fired from outside the town. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-44512912 (BBC)]
;Law and crime
*[[Wynn Resorts|Wynn Resorts Ltd.]] says that two board members, including one investigating sexual misconduct allegations against former Chief Executive [[Steve Wynn]], will leave their posts after [[Elaine Wynn]], the company's largest shareholder, presses for additional board changes. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/two-more-wynn-resorts-directors-to-leave-board-1526336818 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]]
**A shooting takes place at the Art All Night art festival in [[Trenton, New Jersey]]. A suspect is killed and 20 other people injured. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/new-jersey-arts-festival-shooting-leaves-20-injured-1-suspect-dead-officials-say/ar-AAyKOnD?ocid=spartanntp (Fox News via MSN)]
;Politics and elections 
*[[Colombian presidential election, 2018]]
**[[Iván Duque]] wins the second round presidential election to become the new [[President of Colombia|President]] of [[Colombia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-44513368 (BBC)]
*[[Cambodian general election, 2018]]
**A [[FUNCINPEC]] party SUV's head-on collision  in southwest [[Cambodia]] with a taxi seriously injures former  [[Prime Minister of Cambodia|Prime Minister]] [[Norodom Ranariddh|Prince Norodom Ranariddh]] and kills his wife  Ouk Phalla; both were standing as candidates in the upcoming election. Seven other people were also injured. [https://www.stuff.co.nz/world/asia/104807695/wife-of-cambodian-prince-killed-in-car-crash (AP via ''Stuff'')]
;Sports
*[[2018 FIFA World Cup]]
**In an upset victory, [[Mexico national football team|Mexico]] beats [[Germany national football team|Germany]] 1–0, handing them their first opening loss in a [[FIFA World Cup|World Cup]] since [[1982 FIFA World Cup|1982]]. [https://www.tsn.ca/lozano-leads-mexico-to-upset-victory-over-germany-1.1115195 (TSN)]
*[[2018 U.S. Open (golf)]]
**[[Brooks Koepka]] wins his second consecutive U.S. Open Championship of Golf, held in 2018 at [[Shinnecock Hills Golf Club]] in [[Shinnecock Hills, New York]]. [https://www.pga.com/archive/events/usopen/brooks-koepka-becomes-second-player-last-66-years-win-back-back-us-open-titles%3famp=1 (PGA)]
